# CANDIDATE: VWAP_PULLBACK_TO_RIBBON_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Price finds support at VWAP when the short-term EMA ribbon is bullish, offering a high-probability long entry on a pullback. This edge exists because in an uptrend, VWAP often acts as dynamic support, and a pullback to VWAP with a bullish ribbon alignment and RSI oversold condition provides a mean-reversion entry within the uptrend—a combination not present in the registry.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: When price > EMA_20 (uptrend filter) and EMA_9 > EMA_20 (bullish ribbon), and the bar’s low touches VWAP (±0.1% tolerance) with close ≥ VWAP, RSI(14) < 45, and volume > 1.2 × average volume of the last 20 bars, enter long at the bar’s close. Exit shape: Initial stop at the low of the entry bar (chart-stop), target 1.5R; after reaching 1R, trail stop at 15% of ATR from the highest high. Regime hint: Best when VIX < 20 and after 10:00 EST; avoid during FOMC minutes or high-impact news releases.
